producer: NASA / Arizona State University LROC Team
projection: Equirectangular; centered at 0 N, 0 E; west -180 to east 180; south -90 to north 90
map_reference_frame: LRO lunar Mean Earth / polar axis; DE421 MER
sample_kind: 8-bit grayscale browse; visual morphology, not calibrated reflectance

no_data.display: transparent over neutral gray; unavailable imagery, no infill

conversion: Pixel preserving grayscale PNG with alpha 0 only at explicitly tagged no-data value 0; no scaling, reprojection, inpainting or color synthesis
rights: Public domain; cite LROC Team / Arizona State University / NASA
citation: Speyerer, E. J., Robinson, M. S., Denevi, B. W., & LROC Team (2011), Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera Morphological Map of the Moon, LPSC 42, abstract 2387; updates Wagner et al. (2015), LPSC 46, abstract 1473
limits: Historical monochrome mosaic with baked acquisition shadows and source brightness seams
Global map extent includes explicit no-data pixels
Not live imagery; not a terrain model, landing-site survey or radiometric measurement
Geometric illumination of the reference sphere; no terrain self-shadowing or Earthshine
